urls.rationale: 5 ILCS 420 Illinois Governmental Ethics Act — parallel-regime ethics statute containing lobbyist definitions, restricted activities, code-of-conduct provisions, and the Disclosure of Economic Interests article.

5 ILCS 430 State Officials and Employees Ethics Act — parallel-regime statute containing the lobbyist gift ban, revolving-door post-employment lobbying restrictions, and executive/legislative ethics-commission enforcement structure.

notes: Chapter 5 (GENERAL PROVISIONS) is a large catalogue of housekeeping acts; the only two in-scope ILCS acts for lobbying disclosure are 5 ILCS 420 and 5 ILCS 430. All other chapter-5 acts (open meetings, FOIA, salaries, leave, retrocession of federal lands, etc.) are out of scope.
